speaker: Doctor

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fever and altered mentation. I also have Profuse sweating, Generalized rigidity, Confusion and disorientation, Ability to move all limbs, Normal deep tendon reflexes with bilateral downgoing plantar responses.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Neuroleptic Malignant Syndrome (NMS).

The combination of fever, altered mentation, generalized rigidity, and profuse sweating in a patient taking haloperidol is highly characteristic of NMS, even with normal deep tendon reflexes. Do you have a history of recent abrupt discontinuation of antipsychotics or any recent increase in the haloperidol dosage?
